programmes.d: Detectives chase "Fufu," a villain who stole Escobar's stash from the LAPD. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect a witness.

Sixteen-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

Tiara is a social media influencer who goes viral after posting a video of a fallout between her and a man she was dating. In an attempt to keep up her social media momentum, Tiara accepts an invitation to be flown out to meet a man named Josiah.

After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

Diagnosed with breast cancer, Rasheada fights to keep an upbeat facade for friends and family. Her sister Tara and her best friend Bunny struggle with their own demons, while trying to support Rasheada.
When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old Lil August, sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen's l.

As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.

Mikayla is a struggling hopeless romantic. When she meets Jalen, she thinks she's found the one, but he wants a possession over a partner. He demands her loyalty by asking her for a hit list of all of her ex-boyfriends to secure his love.

Keisha is engaged to be married to the man of her dreams, Joseph. Joseph believes he's ready for marriage with the love of his life but his best friend, John, has his doubts about Keisha's faithfulness.

Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her. When a stroke of luck could change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival; after moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club and quickly rises to the top.
